answer: Earliest confirmed attacker activity: 2020-09-18 00:52 UTC — domain accounts (ricksanchez, mortysmith, jerrysmith, summersmith, bethsmith, birdman) created by domain Administrator on CITADEL-DC01, indicating Administrator credential compromise predating the PCAP window. First network-visible malicious activity: 2020-09-18 21:59:39 UTC — DCSync attack from DESKTOP-SDN1RPT (10.42.85.115) against DC01 in the first 92 seconds of PCAP capture. Active external attacker session: 2020-09-19 02:19 UTC (external RDP from 194.61.24.102). CONFIDENCE: HIGH for network events (PCAP absolute timestamps); HIGH for EVTX account creation (artifact-backed). Note: EVTX system clocks on both hosts appear to be UTC+1, corroborated by 1-hour offset between PCAP absolute times and EVTX timestamps for matching events.

answer: Containment window: Attacker activity began no later than 2020-09-18 00:52 UTC (domain account creation). DCSync active at 21:59 UTC Sep 18. Active external intrusion from 2020-09-19 02:19 UTC. Forensic acquisition started ~04:39 UTC Sep 19 (DC01) and ~05:10 UTC (DESKTOP) per EVTX AccessData driver events. The containment window spans approximately 28+ hours from earliest confirmed account creation to acquisition, with the active exfil phase compressed into roughly 02:19–04:00 UTC Sep 19 (under 2 hours). No containment action has been executed yet — both hosts remain not_safe per ASR.

answer: Partial confirmed. DCSync via DRSUAPI (196 frames starting 21:59:39 UTC Sep 18, F-003) extracted all domain hashes including KRBTGT from DC01 — these credential hashes are confirmed exfiltrated through the Meterpreter C2 channel. FileShare\Secret files (Szechuan Sauce.txt 478b, PortalGunPlans.txt 143b, Beth_Secret.txt 27b, NoJerry.txt 25b) were accessed with LNK artifacts (F-014); data volume is consistent with RDP clipboard exfil or Meterpreter download command within the C2 sessions (DESKTOP sent 0.24MB, DC01 sent 0.11MB to 203.78.103.109:443). The previously-suspected 36MB OneDrive transfer was corrected as an INBOUND download (OneDrive auto-update, F-017) — no bulk file exfil via OneDrive confirmed. Mortysmith's SSN (584-99-5601) and Portal Gun Plans were at risk on DESKTOP via the active Meterpreter session.

answer: Attacker was ACTIVE at time of memory acquisition. DESKTOP memory shows: (1) live PowerShell Meterpreter session PID 3316 (child of stager PID 508, both still running at acquisition with conhost PID 728) captured by EID 4104 script-block at 05:08:42 UTC Sep 19 (F-013); (2) two orphaned C2 socket artifacts to 203.78.103.109:443 ESTABLISHED in DESKTOP netscan (F-018); (3) active SMB session to DC01:445. DC01 pstree shows coreupdater PID 3644 exited by acquisition but C2 socket artifact to 203.78.103.109:443 remains in pool (F-006, DC01 netscan). The attacker retained at least one live Meterpreter shell on DESKTOP at the time evidence was collected.
